text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
What was I missing...?
Stamina...? Explosive power...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...The general direction of the training is fine...
If so, then what needs review is the specific content—"
choice_data_list: If we're reviewing the race, let's do it together.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Missing out on victory is my responsibility.
I should have been greedier for the win..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Victory, and narrow defeat.
...It means nothing unless I shoulder it myself.
choice_data_list: There were good points too. Let's build on those!
Then, put your thoughts together and give me a report.
Then, put your thoughts together and submit a report.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
That is certainly a point we must keep in mind."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: If you notice anything, please incorporate it into the training.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I will obey... if it's to become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...If that's the case, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Writing it down in words
helps me sort out my thoughts, so...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will contact you once it is completed.
...Thank you for your hard work.
